scope: This discharges the nonzero-scale normalization, exceptional-ratio exclusion, and pairwise-nonsquare radicand premise for the A nonzero interval branch. It does not construct the Semaev summation polynomial or original zero-sum point relation, prove torsion-to-division-polynomial vanishing, handle the A equals zero cubic-character collision branch, or establish the full subexponential ECDLP runtime theorem.
statement: For a nonsingular prime-field short curve with A nonzero, any injectively indexed family of positive natural scales whose pairwise sums are below the modulus yields short-cubic function-field radicands whose distinct pair products are nonsquares.
